title: Water: a precious resource
examples: Where do we find the most fresh water on Earth?
What can we do at home to save water?
What happens when there is a drought?

explain.say: Today we learn about water, which is very important for life.
Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: the water cycle. Look at the sun, the evaporation and the condensation. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
Most of the water on Earth is actually salt water from the ocean.

draw.text: Salt water is most of Earth's water.

explain.say: Fresh water is much rarer than we might think, even though it seems everywhere.
We must learn how to save water every single day at home and school.

items: Turn off the tap while brushing

draw.text: Saving water is important for everyone.

explain.say: A drought happens when there is not enough water for a long time.
In real life, we see water conservation when people use rainwater barrels.

faq.q: How much of Earth's water is actually fresh water?
faq.a: Only a small percentage of Earth's water is fresh. Most of it is salt water in the oceans.
asks: Is all the water on Earth usable?
Where does the fresh water go?

faq.q: What is the difference between saving water and conservation?
faq.a: Saving water means using less water right now. Conservation is a bigger effort to protect water sources.

faq.q: What causes a drought to happen?
faq.a: A drought happens when there is a long period with little or no rain. This affects rivers and plants.
asks: What is the cause of drought?

faq.q: If we use less water, does it help the planet?
faq.a: Yes, using less water helps keep clean sources available for everyone. It protects local ecosystems too.
asks: Is saving water good for nature?
Why should we care about water levels?

faq.q: Is all fresh water usable for drinking?
faq.a: No, much fresh water is locked up in glaciers and ice caps. We need to use other methods to make it drinkable.

facts: The Earth is often called the blue planet because of water.
Salt water from the ocean cannot be easily drunk.
Droughts can make it very hard for farmers to grow food.
Collecting rainwater is a good way to save water at home.

quiz.say: If 97 percent of Earth's water is salt, what percentage is fresh?
quiz.why: The problem states that most water is salt, leaving the remaining small amount as fresh water.

wrong.1: This is wrong because the water is mixed between salt and fresh.
wrong.2: This is wrong because 97 percent is the amount of salt water, not the total.
wrong.3: This is wrong because it is a larger fraction than just one percent.

quiz.say: Which action helps prevent water shortages?
quiz.show: Short showers, fix leaks, save water

options.show: Washing cars only once a month
options.say: Washing cars only once a month

quiz.why: Taking shorter showers directly reduces the amount of water used by a person.

wrong.1: This is too extreme; we still need to clean things sometimes.
wrong.2: This is wrong because we need water for plants and cleaning too.
wrong.3: While dams help, saving water at the source is also very important.

quiz.say: When does a drought typically affect human life the most?
quiz.why: Low rivers show that the water supply is dwindling, which affects everything downstream.

wrong.1: A blue sky does not mean there is enough water to live.
wrong.2: Strong winds move air, but they do not equal available water.
wrong.3: Cloudy weather can happen even if there is no rain coming.
